moments.title: Premier League Monday Night Football
moments.blurb: Tottenham Hotspur host Coventry City in the final fixture of Premier League Matchweek 7 tonight.

angles.name: Match Preview
angles.copy: Monday Night Football! Spurs take on Coventry City in the Premier League tonight. Big points at stake to round off Matchweek 7.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing: Icons Week Fallout
moments.blurb: Dame Sarah Storey and Julian Caillon became the third couple to leave Strictly Come Dancing last night after Icons Week.

angles.name: Results Reaction
angles.copy: Another Strictly Sunday, another elimination! Dame Sarah Storey and Julian Caillon danced their last after Icons Week. Did the right couple go home?

angles.name: Next Week Tease
angles.copy: Who's still in the running for the Glitterball? Strictly returns Saturday 24th October at 6:30pm for Week 5!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Week 5
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off Series 17 continues this Tuesday as the remaining bakers face a new set of challenges in the tent.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Tuesday means one thing: new Bake Off! What culinary creations and catastrophes await in the tent this week? Get your snacks ready!

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! Teaser
moments.blurb: Ant & Dec have released the first festive-themed trailer for I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here!, which returns to ITV on November 16th.

angles.name: Trailer Drop
angles.copy: The jungle bells are ringing! Ant & Dec have dropped the first trailer for I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! Who do you want to see in the camp this year?

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending October 24th sees new entries from Olivia Rodrigo and Robyn, alongside re-entries from P!nk and The Killers.

angles.name: Chart Movers
angles.copy: New music alert! Olivia Rodrigo and Robyn are new in the charts, while P!nk and The Killers re-enter the Top 40. What are you streaming this week?

angles.name: Artist Spotlight
angles.copy: Robyn's 'Dancing On My Own' is back in the UK Top 40 this week! A timeless classic for a reason.

moments.title: Halloween Countdown
moments.blurb: With Halloween just under two weeks away, events and spooky activities are in full swing across the UK.

angles.name: Spooky Season
angles.copy: The Halloween countdown is on! From fright nights to pumpkin patches, what spooky plans do you have for the run-up to October 31st?

angles.name: Half-Term Fun
angles.copy: October half-term for many starts next week, perfectly timed for Halloween fun! Theme parks like Alton Towers and Thorpe Park have their Scarefests running.

moments.title: RAYE at Royal Albert Hall
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter RAYE is set to perform at the iconic Royal Albert Hall in London this Friday, October 23rd.

angles.name: Gig Buzz
angles.copy: London's buzzing for RAYE this Friday! She takes to the stage at the legendary Royal Albert Hall. Who's got tickets?

moments.title: Wyclef Jean's 57th Birthday

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to the incredible Wyclef Jean! From Fugees classics to solo hits, what's your favourite track from him?

angles.name: Birthday Anticipation
angles.copy: Get ready to wish the Doggfather a happy birthday! Snoop Dogg turns 55 tomorrow. Drop your favourite Snoop track to celebrate!

angles.name: It Wasn't Me?
angles.copy: He's still got it! Shaggy celebrates his 58th birthday this Thursday. What's your go-to Shaggy hit?

angles.name: Big 4-0 for Drizzy
angles.copy: Drizzy hits the big 4-0 this Friday! Celebrate Drake's birthday by telling us your favourite track from the Champagne Papi.

angles.name: Guitar Hero Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 69th Birthday to the legendary Steve Lukather of Toto! A true guitar hero and session ace. What's your favourite Toto track?

angles.name: Prog Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 82nd Birthday to Jon Anderson, the distinctive voice of Yes! Celebrate with your favourite prog rock epic.
